scope: Short smoke tests, not sustained fuzzing or a safety certification.

sanitizers.reason: LeakSanitizer cannot inspect processes in this ptrace-based local environment.

corpus: Seeds plus locally discovered inputs from earlier smoke runs; mutation corpora are not versioned.
findings_fixed: A run of unary operators before an invalid token caused exponential parser backtracking. A preparse limit and semantic regression now reject it.

runs.command: ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0 cargo +nightly-2026-09-07 fuzz run preprocess fuzz/corpus/preprocess -- -max_total_time=60 -timeout=5 -rss_limit_mb=1024 -print_final_stats=1
ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0 cargo +nightly-2026-09-07 fuzz run semantic fuzz/corpus/semantic -- -max_total_time=60 -timeout=5 -rss_limit_mb=1024 -print_final_stats=1
ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0 cargo +nightly-2026-09-07 fuzz run bindings fuzz/corpus/bindings -- -max_total_time=60 -timeout=5 -rss_limit_mb=1024 -print_final_stats=1
